=== Operation 1 Result (Text) ===
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
  output   = "../app/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

enum Role {
  SUPER_ADMIN
  ADMIN
  EDITOR
}

enum PlaceType {
  NORMAL
  NIGHT
}

enum BillingStatus {
  UNPAID
  INVOICED
  PAID
}

enum InquiryType {
  STORE_LISTING
  GENERAL
}

enum InquiryStatus {
  PENDING
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
}

enum ArticleType {
  NEWS
  GUIDE
}

enum ImpactLevel {
  HIGH
  MEDIUM
  LOW
}

enum NewsCategory {
  ALL
  LIFE
  TRANSPORT
  BUSINESS
  NIGHT
  EVENT
  SYSTEM
}

// ─── Admin Users ───

model AdminUser {
  id            String      @id @default(uuid())
  loginId       String?     @unique
  email         String      @unique
  password      String
  name          String
  role          Role        @default(EDITOR)
  customRole    String?     // FK to CustomRole.code — overrides enum role for permission lookups
  customRoleRef CustomRole? @relation(fields: [customRole], references: [code])
  active        Boolean     @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime    @updatedAt

  @@map("admin_users")
}

// ─── Users (Public) ───

model User {
  id                String    @id @default(uuid())
  email             String    @unique
  password          String
  fullName          String
  nickname          String?   @unique
  avatarUrl         String?
  bio               String?   @db.VarChar(140)
  emailVerified     Boolean   @default(false)
  verificationToken String?   @unique
  tokenExpiresAt    DateTime?
  active            Boolean   @default(true)
  frozen            Boolean   @default(false)
  deletedAt         DateTime?
  lastLoginAt       DateTime?
  loginFailCount    Int       @default(0)
  loginLockedUntil  DateTime?
  totalLikesReceived Int      @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime  @updatedAt

  communityPosts   CommunityPost[]
  communityReplies CommunityReply[]
  qaQuestions      QaQuestion[]
  qaAnswers        QaAnswer[]
  qaLikes          QaLike[]
  qaWatches        QaWatch[]
  qaReports        QaReport[]

  @@index([email])
  @@map("users")
}

// ─── Areas ───

model Area {
  id                 String            @id @default(uuid())
  slug               String            @unique
  displayOrder       Int               @default(0)
  enabled            Boolean           @default(true)
  imageUrl           String?
  description        String?           @db.Text
  seoTitle           String?
  seoDescription     String?
  googleMapsUrl      String?
  btsStation         String?
  ratingJapanese     Int               @default(0)
  ratingNightlife    Int               @default(0)
  ratingBeginner     Int               @default(0)
  ratingNightCaution Int               @default(0)
  createdAt          DateTime          @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime          @updatedAt
  translations       AreaTranslation[]
  places             Place[]

  @@map("areas")
}

model AreaTranslation {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  areaId String
  locale String
  name   String
  area   Area   @relation(fields: [areaId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([areaId, locale])
  @@map("area_translations")
}

// ─── Categories ───

model Category {
  id             String                @id @default(uuid())
  slug           String                @unique
  displayOrder   Int                   @default(0)
  enabled        Boolean               @default(true)
  description    String?               @db.Text
  seoTitle       String?
  seoDescription String?
  imageUrl       String?
  createdAt      DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime              @updatedAt
  translations   CategoryTranslation[]
  places         PlaceCategory[]

  @@map("categories")
}

model CategoryTranslation {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  categoryId String
  locale     String
  name       String
  category   Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([categoryId, locale])
  @@map("category_translations")
}

// ─── Scenes ───

model Scene {
  id           String             @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String?            @unique
  icon         String?
  displayOrder Int                @default(0)
  enabled      Boolean            @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime           @updatedAt
  translations SceneTranslation[]
  places       PlaceScene[]

  @@map("scenes")
}

model SceneTranslation {
  id      String @id @default(uuid())
  sceneId String
  locale  String
  name    String
  scene   Scene  @relation(fields: [sceneId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([sceneId, locale])
  @@map("scene_translations")
}

// ─── Tags ───

model Tag {
  id           String           @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String           @unique
  displayOrder Int              @default(0)
  category     String?
  createdAt    DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime         @updatedAt
  translations TagTranslation[]
  placeTags    PlaceTag[]
  articleTags  ArticleTag[]

  @@map("tags")
}

model TagTranslation {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  tagId  String
  locale String
  name   String
  tag    Tag    @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([tagId, locale])
  @@map("tag_translations")
}

// ─── Owners (Companies) ───

model Owner {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  companyName String
  contactName String
  phone       String
  email       String
  memo        String?  @db.Text
  active      Boolean  @default(true)
  planId      String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  plan     PricingPlan?     @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  places   Place[]
  billings MonthlyBilling[]

  @@map("owners")
}

// ─── Pricing Plans ───

model PricingPlan {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  name            String
  monthlyPrice    Int
  description     String?  @db.Text
  enabled         Boolean  @default(true)
  displayPriority Int      @default(0)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  owners        Owner[]
  storeBillings StoreBilling[]

  @@map("pricing_plans")
}

// ─── Places (Stores) ───

model Place {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  slug           String    @unique
  type           PlaceType @default(NORMAL)
  isVisible      Boolean   @default(false)
  areaId         String?
  ownerId        String?
  phone          String?
  address        String?
  openingHours   String?   @db.Text
  price          String?   @db.Text
  menu           String?   @db.Text
  nearestStation String?
  regularHoliday String?
  languages      String[]
  website        String?
  snsInstagram   String?
  snsX           String?
  snsFacebook    String?
  snsLine        String?
  snsTiktok      String?
  showSpotlight  Boolean   @default(false)
  showNightNavi  Boolean   @default(false)
  displayPriority Int      @default(0)
  googleMapsUrl  String?
  googleRating   Float?
  googleReviewCount Int?
  priceFrom      Int?
  priceTo        Int?
  seoTitle       String?
  seoDescription String?
  h1Tag          String?
  noindex        Boolean   @default(false)
  viewCount      Int       @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  area         Area?              @relation(fields: [areaId], references: [id])
  owner        Owner?             @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  translations PlaceTranslation[]
  images       PlaceImage[]
  tags         PlaceTag[]
  categories   PlaceCategory[]
  scenes       PlaceScene[]
  storeBillings StoreBilling[]
  jobs         Job[]
  curatedLists CuratedListPlace[]

  @@index([type, isVisible])
  @@index([areaId])
  @@index([ownerId])
  @@map("places")
}

model PlaceTranslation {
  id          String @id @default(uuid())
  placeId     String
  locale      String
  name        String
  description String @db.Text
  place       Place  @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([placeId, locale])
  @@map("place_translations")
}

model PlaceImage {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  placeId   String
  url       String
  alt       String?
  isMain    Boolean  @default(false)
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  place     Place    @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("place_images")
}

model PlaceTag {
  placeId String
  tagId   String
  place   Place @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tag     Tag   @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([placeId, tagId])
  @@map("place_tags")
}

model PlaceCategory {
  placeId    String
  categoryId String
  place      Place    @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  category   Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([placeId, categoryId])
  @@map("place_categories")
}

model PlaceScene {
  placeId String
  sceneId String
  place   Place @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scene   Scene @relation(fields: [sceneId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([placeId, sceneId])
  @@map("place_scenes")
}

// ─── Revenue / Billing ───

model MonthlyBilling {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId     String
  year        Int
  month       Int
  totalAmount Int           @default(0)
  status      BillingStatus @default(UNPAID)
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt

  owner  Owner          @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  stores StoreBilling[]

  @@unique([ownerId, year, month])
  @@map("monthly_billings")
}

model StoreBilling {
  id               String  @id @default(uuid())
  monthlyBillingId String
  placeId          String
  planId           String?
  amount           Int     @default(0)
  active           Boolean @default(true)
  note             String?

  monthlyBilling MonthlyBilling @relation(fields: [monthlyBillingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  place          Place          @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id])
  plan           PricingPlan?   @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])

  @@map("store_billings")
}

// ─── Featured Pages ───

model FeaturedPage {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  title        String
  url          String
  displayOrder Int      @default(0)
  enabled      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("featured_pages")
}

// ─── Global Settings ───

model GlobalSettings {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  key       String   @unique
  value     String
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("global_settings")
}

// ─── Articles ───

model Article {
  id             String               @id @default(uuid())
  slug           String               @unique
  type           ArticleType
  published      Boolean              @default(false)
  featured       Boolean              @default(false)
  impactLevel    ImpactLevel?
  newsCategory   NewsCategory?
  sourceUrl      String?
  seoTitle       String?
  seoDescription String?
  ogTitle        String?
  ogImage        String?
  canonicalUrl   String?
  schemaType     String?              // Article, HowTo, FAQ
  viewCount      Int                  @default(0)
  publishedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime             @updatedAt
  translations   ArticleTranslation[]
  tags           ArticleTag[]

  @@index([type, published])
  @@map("articles")
}

model ArticleTag {
  articleId String
  tagId     String
  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  tag       Tag     @relation(fields: [tagId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([articleId, tagId])
  @@map("article_tags")
}

model ArticleTranslation {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  articleId String
  locale    String
  title     String
  content   String  @db.Text
  excerpt   String?
  coverUrl  String?
  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([articleId, locale])
  @@map("article_translations")
}

// ─── Community ───

model CommunityPost {
  id        String           @id @default(uuid())
  title     String
  content   String           @db.Text
  authorId  String?
  locale    String           @default("ja")
  hidden    Boolean          @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime         @updatedAt
  replies   CommunityReply[]
  author    User?            @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([hidden, createdAt])
  @@map("community_posts")
}

model CommunityReply {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid())
  postId    String
  content   String        @db.Text
  authorId  String?
  hidden    Boolean       @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime      @updatedAt
  post      CommunityPost @relation(fields: [postId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  author    User?         @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([postId])
  @@map("community_replies")
}

// ─── Stations ───

model Station {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  name         String
  line         String?  // BTS, MRT, ARL
  displayOrder Int      @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@map("stations")
}

// ─── Inquiries (掲載依頼) ───

model Inquiry {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid())
  type      InquiryType
  status    InquiryStatus @default(PENDING)
  name      String
  email     String
  phone     String?
  storeName String?
  subject   String
  message   String        @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime      @updatedAt

  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@map("inquiries")
}

// ─── Jobs ───

model Job {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  company     String
  title       String
  category    String
  location    String
  url         String?
  description String?  @db.Text
  imageUrl    String?
  placeId     String?
  active      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  place       Place?   @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([active, createdAt])
  @@map("jobs")
}

// ─── Curated Lists ───

model CuratedList {
  id           String             @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String             @unique
  title        String
  description  String?            @db.Text
  published    Boolean            @default(false)
  displayOrder Int                @default(0)
  seoTitle     String?
  seoDescription String?
  coverUrl     String?
  createdAt    DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime           @updatedAt
  places       CuratedListPlace[]

  @@map("curated_lists")
}

model CuratedListPlace {
  curatedListId String
  placeId       String
  order         Int          @default(0)
  curatedList   CuratedList  @relation(fields: [curatedListId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  place         Place        @relation(fields: [placeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([curatedListId, placeId])
  @@map("curated_list_places")
}

// ─── Media ───

model Media {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  url       String
  filename  String
  mimeType  String
  size      Int
  publicId  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@map("media")
}

// ─── Custom Roles ───

model CustomRole {
  id          String           @id @default(uuid())
  code        String           @unique // e.g. "ADMIN", "EDITOR", "CONTENT_MANAGER" — uppercase
  name        String           // display name e.g. "コンテンツ管理者"
  description String?          @db.Text
  isSystem    Boolean          @default(false) // true for SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, EDITOR
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime         @updatedAt

  permissions RolePermission[] // all permission rows for this role
  adminUsers  AdminUser[]      // admin users assigned this custom role

  @@map("custom_roles")
}

// ─── Role Permissions ───

model RolePermission {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  role       String     // FK to CustomRole.code
  resource   String     // e.g. "stores", "articles", "revenue", "settings"
  canView    Boolean    @default(false)
  canCreate  Boolean    @default(false)
  canEdit    Boolean    @default(false)
  canDelete  Boolean    @default(false)

  customRole CustomRole @relation(fields: [role], references: [code])

  @@unique([role, resource])
  @@map("role_permissions")
}

// ─── Q&A ───

enum QaReportStatus {
  PENDING
  RESOLVED
  DISMISSED
}

model QaQuestion {
  id           String      @id @default(uuid())
  slug         String      @unique
  title        String
  content      String      @db.Text
  authorId     String?
  hidden       Boolean     @default(false)
  closed       Boolean     @default(false)
  viewCount    Int         @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime    @updatedAt

  author    User?        @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  answers   QaAnswer[]
  watches   QaWatch[]
  reports   QaReport[]

  @@index([hidden, createdAt])
  @@map("qa_questions")
}

model QaAnswer {
  id             String     @id @default(uuid())
  questionId     String
  parentId       String?    // for nested replies
  content        String     @db.Text
  authorId       String?
  isBest         Boolean    @default(false)
  isOldFlag      Boolean    @default(false)  // auto-flagged if > threshold months
  hidden         Boolean    @default(false)
  likeCount      Int        @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime   @updatedAt

  question  QaQuestion  @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  parent    QaAnswer?   @relation("AnswerReplies", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  replies   QaAnswer[]  @relation("AnswerReplies")
  author    User?       @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  likes     QaLike[]
  reports   QaReport[]

  @@index([questionId])
  @@map("qa_answers")
}

model QaLike {
  id       String   @id @default(uuid())
  answerId String
  userId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  answer QaAnswer @relation(fields: [answerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user   User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([answerId, userId])
  @@map("qa_likes")
}

model QaWatch {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  questionId String
  userId     String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  question QaQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([questionId, userId])
  @@map("qa_watches")
}

model QaReport {
  id         String         @id @default(uuid())
  questionId String?
  answerId   String?
  reporterId String?
  reason     String
  status     QaReportStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt  DateTime       @default(now())

  question QaQuestion? @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answer   QaAnswer?   @relation(fields: [answerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reporter User?       @relation(fields: [reporterId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([status])
  @@map("qa_reports")
}

// ─── Today Events ───

model TodayEvent {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  eventTime    String
  area         String
  title        String
  description  String?  @db.Text
  imageUrls    String[] @default([])
  eventDate    DateTime @default(now()) @db.Date
  active       Boolean  @default(true)
  submittedBy  String?  // userId if submitted by public user
  contactUrl   String?
  lineId       String?
  contactEmail String?
  contactPhone String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([eventDate, active])
  @@map("today_events")
}

Now I have a thorough picture of the entire codebase. Here's a complete, structured overview:

---

## Codebase Overview — バンコクデイズ (Bangkok Days)

**Project**: Portal site for Japanese residents in Bangkok, combining a public-facing frontend with a full admin management panel.

**Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL + Prisma 7 (with `@prisma/adapter-pg`), NextAuth.js 4, Zod, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Tiptap, Cloudinary, Sonner, TanStack Query.

---

### Database Schema (`prisma/schema.prisma`)

**35+ models** across these domains:

| Domain | Models |
|--------|--------|
| Admin auth | `AdminUser`, `CustomRole`, `RolePermission` |
| Public users | `User` |
| Geography | `Area`, `AreaTranslation` |
| Taxonomy | `Category`, `CategoryTranslation`, `Scene`, `SceneTranslation`, `Tag`, `TagTranslation`, `Station` |
| Stores | `Place`, `PlaceTranslation`, `PlaceImage`, `PlaceTag`, `PlaceCategory`, `PlaceScene` |
| Business | `Owner`, `PricingPlan`, `MonthlyBilling`, `StoreBilling` |
| Content | `Article`, `ArticleTranslation`, `ArticleTag`, `CuratedList`, `CuratedListPlace` |
| Community | `CommunityPost`, `CommunityReply` |
| Q&A | `QaQuestion`, `QaAnswer`, `QaLike`, `QaWatch`, `QaReport` |
| Events | `TodayEvent` |
| Jobs | `Job` |
| System | `Inquiry`, `GlobalSettings`, `Media`, `FeaturedPage` |

All translatable entities use a `{Model}Translation` pattern with `locale` (ja/en/th). The Prisma client is generated to `app/generated/prisma/` and uses the `PrismaPg` adapter for direct PostgreSQL connections.

---

### Auth (`lib/auth-options.ts`, `lib/auth.ts`, `lib/user-auth.ts`)

Two NextAuth credential providers:
- **`admin-credentials`** — matches by `email` OR `loginId`, checks `active` flag, returns `role`, `customRole`, `userType: "admin"`
- **`user-credentials`** — public users, with lockout after 5 failed attempts (15 min), checks `emailVerified`

JWT tokens carry `role`, `customRole`, `userType`, `emailVerified`. The `types/next-auth.d.ts` extends the Session/User/JWT types to include these fields.

**Server helpers**:
- `requireAuth()` — throws 401 if not logged in
- `requireRole(roles[])` — checks effective role
- `requireUser()` / `requireVerifiedUser()` — for public user routes

---

### Permission System (`lib/permissions.ts`, `lib/permissions-config.ts`)

**Granular RBAC** on top of enum roles:
- Every `AdminUser` has an enum `role` (SUPER_ADMIN / ADMIN / EDITOR)
- `customRole` (string FK to `CustomRole.code`) overrides the enum role for permission lookups
- `getEffectiveRole()` returns `customRole ?? role`
- `requirePermission(resource, action)` — SUPER_ADMIN bypasses; others checked against `RolePermission` table (21 resources × 4 actions: canView/canCreate/canEdit/canDelete)
- Client-side: `usePermissions()` hook fetches `/api/v1/admin/permissions/me` and exposes `can(resource, action)`

**21 permission resources**: `stores`, `articles`, `areas`, `categories`, `scenes`, `tags`, `owners`, `revenue`, `pricing_plans`, `inquiries`, `featured`, `curated_lists`, `today_events`, `jobs`, `auto_news`, `media`, `community`, `qa`, `settings`, `admin_users`, `users`.

Default seeded permissions (`scripts/seed-permissions.ts`): ADMIN gets full access on all except `admin_users` delete. EDITOR gets view/create/edit on content, blocked on `revenue`, `pricing_plans`, `settings`, `admin_users`, `users`.

---

### Core Lib Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `lib/prisma.ts` | Singleton Prisma client using `PrismaPg` adapter; dev global cache |
| `lib/api-response.ts` | `success()`, `error()`, `paginated()` — standardized NextResponse wrappers; handles Prisma P2002/P2025 errors, Zod errors, `ApiError` |
| `lib/errors.ts` | `ApiError` class + factory helpers (`unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `notFound`, `badRequest`, `conflict`) |
| `lib/password.ts` | `hashPassword` / `verifyPassword` via bcryptjs (cost 10) |
| `lib/cloudinary.ts` | Client-side upload helper (uses `upload_preset`) |
| `lib/email.ts` | Nodemailer SMTP transporter; `sendEmail()` + `sendVerificationEmail()` |
| `lib/utils.ts` | `cn()` — clsx + tailwind-merge |
| `lib/badges.ts` | Q&A badge system using `GlobalSettings` key `qa_badges`; default 5 badge tiers |
| `lib/public-api.ts` | Client-side typed fetchers for all public API endpoints + TypeScript interfaces for all entities |
| `lib/admin-api.ts` | Admin-side fetch wrappers: `storesApi`, `areasApi`, `categoriesApi`, `scenesApi`, `tagsApi`, `ownersApi`, `pricingPlansApi`, `revenueApi`, `inquiriesApi`, `featuredPagesApi`, `settingsApi`, `googleMapsApi`, `articlesApi`, `jobsApi` |
| `lib/use-permissions.ts` | `usePermissions()` React hook |
| `lib/user-auth.ts` | `getUserSession()`, `requireUser()`, `requireVerifiedUser()` |

---

### Validation Schemas (`lib/validations/`)

All Zod-based:
- `place.ts` — `createPlaceSchema`, `updatePlaceSchema`, `placeFilterSchema`
- `article.ts` — `createArticleSchema`, `updateArticleSchema`, `articleFilterSchema`

### Admin Panel UI (`app/admin/`)

1. **Permission-first APIs**: Every admin route calls `requirePermission(resource, action)` as the first line — any exception bubbles to the `error()` handler.
2. **Auto SEO generation**: Store create/update auto-generates `seoTitle`, `seoDescription`, `h1Tag` from `name + areaName + categoryName` if not explicitly provided.
3. **Auto-news pipeline**: RSS fetch → OpenAI GPT-4o-mini rewrite → trigram dedup → Cloudinary image upload → Article create. Capped at 5 articles per run to avoid Neon serverless timeouts.
4. **`/api/v1/today` aggregation**: Single endpoint combining weather (Open-Meteo), air quality (Open-Meteo Air Quality API), exchange rate (open.er-api.com), and `TodayEvent` DB records — cached 60s.
5. **Translation pattern**: All UI text is in Japanese; the translation table pattern allows en/th content for stores/areas/articles — the public API accepts a `locale` param.
6. **Image crop**: Upload flow always goes through `ImageCropper` (react-easy-crop) before uploading, ensuring consistent aspect ratios.
7. **Soft delete for users**: Public user deletion sets `deletedAt`, anonymizes email/nickname, keeps posts.
8. **Custom roles**: The `CustomRole` + `RolePermission` system fully extends the 3-enum roles with fine-grained per-resource CRUD permissions, assignable per admin user.

## まとめ

### 1. 日付設定について
**不要です。** 省略すると最新のRSS記事をそのまま処理します。日付は「過去の特定期間を再取得したい時だけ」使うオプション機能です。

### 2. ブラウザバックでフィルターがリセットされる問題 → 修正完了

**根本原因：**
フィルター状態を `useState` で管理しつつ `router.replace()` でURLを更新していたため、2つの状態が乖離していました。具体的には：

- ブラウザバック → コンポーネント再マウント → `useState` の初期値（空文字）が先に適用
- マスターデータ（areas/categories）の非同期取得が終わる前に初期レンダーが完了してしまう

**修正内容（URL-first アーキテクチャに変更）：**

| 変更前 | 変更後 |
|--------|--------|
| `useState` がフィルターの正 | `searchParams`（URL）がフィルターの正 |
| フィルター変更 → `setState` + `router.replace()` | フィルター変更 → `router.replace()` のみ |
| ブラウザバック時に `useState` がリセット | URLが復元されるので自動的にフィルターも復元 |

```
エリアを選択 → URL: /shops?area=sukhumvit
店舗をクリック → /shops/xxx へ遷移
ブラウザバック → URL: /shops?area=sukhumvit が復元
          → searchParams から areaSlugParam = "sukhumvit" を読み取り
          → スクンビットが選択された状態で表示 ✅
```

## Codebase Overview — バンコクデイズ (Bangkok Days)

**Project**: Portal site for Japanese residents in Bangkok, combining a public-facing frontend with a full admin management panel.

**Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL + Prisma 7 (with `@prisma/adapter-pg`), NextAuth.js 4, Zod, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Tiptap, Cloudinary, Sonner, TanStack Query.

---

### Database Schema (`prisma/schema.prisma`)

**35+ models** across these domains:

| Domain | Models |
|--------|--------|
| Admin auth | `AdminUser`, `CustomRole`, `RolePermission` |
| Public users | `User` |
| Geography | `Area`, `AreaTranslation` |
| Taxonomy | `Category`, `CategoryTranslation`, `Scene`, `SceneTranslation`, `Tag`, `TagTranslation`, `Station` |
| Stores | `Place`, `PlaceTranslation`, `PlaceImage`, `PlaceTag`, `PlaceCategory`, `PlaceScene` |
| Business | `Owner`, `PricingPlan`, `MonthlyBilling`, `StoreBilling` |
| Content | `Article`, `ArticleTranslation`, `ArticleTag`, `CuratedList`, `CuratedListPlace` |
| Community | `CommunityPost`, `CommunityReply` |
| Q&A | `QaQuestion`, `QaAnswer`, `QaLike`, `QaWatch`, `QaReport` |
| Events | `TodayEvent` |
| Jobs | `Job` |
| System | `Inquiry`, `GlobalSettings`, `Media`, `FeaturedPage` |

All translatable entities use a `{Model}Translation` pattern with `locale` (ja/en/th). The Prisma client is generated to `app/generated/prisma/` and uses the `PrismaPg` adapter for direct PostgreSQL connections.

---

### Auth (`lib/auth-options.ts`, `lib/auth.ts`, `lib/user-auth.ts`)

Two NextAuth credential providers:
- **`admin-credentials`** — matches by `email` OR `loginId`, checks `active` flag, returns `role`, `customRole`, `userType: "admin"`
- **`user-credentials`** — public users, with lockout after 5 failed attempts (15 min), checks `emailVerified`

JWT tokens carry `role`, `customRole`, `userType`, `emailVerified`. The `types/next-auth.d.ts` extends the Session/User/JWT types to include these fields.

**Server helpers**:
- `requireAuth()` — throws 401 if not logged in
- `requireRole(roles[])` — checks effective role
- `requireUser()` / `requireVerifiedUser()` — for public user routes

---

### Permission System (`lib/permissions.ts`, `lib/permissions-config.ts`)

**Granular RBAC** on top of enum roles:
- Every `AdminUser` has an enum `role` (SUPER_ADMIN / ADMIN / EDITOR)
- `customRole` (string FK to `CustomRole.code`) overrides the enum role for permission lookups
- `getEffectiveRole()` returns `customRole ?? role`
- `requirePermission(resource, action)` — SUPER_ADMIN bypasses; others checked against `RolePermission` table (21 resources × 4 actions: canView/canCreate/canEdit/canDelete)
- Client-side: `usePermissions()` hook fetches `/api/v1/admin/permissions/me` and exposes `can(resource, action)`

**21 permission resources**: `stores`, `articles`, `areas`, `categories`, `scenes`, `tags`, `owners`, `revenue`, `pricing_plans`, `inquiries`, `featured`, `curated_lists`, `today_events`, `jobs`, `auto_news`, `media`, `community`, `qa`, `settings`, `admin_users`, `users`.

Default seeded permissions (`scripts/seed-permissions.ts`): ADMIN gets full access on all except `admin_users` delete. EDITOR gets view/create/edit on content, blocked on `revenue`, `pricing_plans`, `settings`, `admin_users`, `users`.

---

### Core Lib Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `lib/prisma.ts` | Singleton Prisma client using `PrismaPg` adapter; dev global cache |
| `lib/api-response.ts` | `success()`, `error()`, `paginated()` — standardized NextResponse wrappers; handles Prisma P2002/P2025 errors, Zod errors, `ApiError` |
| `lib/errors.ts` | `ApiError` class + factory helpers (`unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `notFound`, `badRequest`, `conflict`) |
| `lib/password.ts` | `hashPassword` / `verifyPassword` via bcryptjs (cost 10) |
| `lib/cloudinary.ts` | Client-side upload helper (uses `upload_preset`) |
| `lib/email.ts` | Nodemailer SMTP transporter; `sendEmail()` + `sendVerificationEmail()` |
| `lib/utils.ts` | `cn()` — clsx + tailwind-merge |
| `lib/badges.ts` | Q&A badge system using `GlobalSettings` key `qa_badges`; default 5 badge tiers |
| `lib/public-api.ts` | Client-side typed fetchers for all public API endpoints + TypeScript interfaces for all entities |
| `lib/admin-api.ts` | Admin-side fetch wrappers: `storesApi`, `areasApi`, `categoriesApi`, `scenesApi`, `tagsApi`, `ownersApi`, `pricingPlansApi`, `revenueApi`, `inquiriesApi`, `featuredPagesApi`, `settingsApi`, `googleMapsApi`, `articlesApi`, `jobsApi` |
| `lib/use-permissions.ts` | `usePermissions()` React hook |
| `lib/user-auth.ts` | `getUserSession()`, `requireUser()`, `requireVerifiedUser()` |

---

### Validation Schemas (`lib/validations/`)

All Zod-based:
- `place.ts` — `createPlaceSchema`, `updatePlaceSchema`, `placeFilterSchema`
- `article.ts` — `createArticleSchema`, `updateArticleSchema`, `articleFilterSchema`

### Notable Patterns

1. **Permission-first APIs**: Every admin route calls `requirePermission(resource, action)` as the first line — any exception bubbles to the `error()` handler.
2. **Auto SEO generation**: Store create/update auto-generates `seoTitle`, `seoDescription`, `h1Tag` from `name + areaName + categoryName` if not explicitly provided.
3. **Auto-news pipeline**: RSS fetch → OpenAI GPT-4o-mini rewrite → trigram dedup → Cloudinary image upload → Article create. Capped at 5 articles per run to avoid Neon serverless timeouts.
4. **`/api/v1/today` aggregation**: Single endpoint combining weather (Open-Meteo), air quality (Open-Meteo Air Quality API), exchange rate (open.er-api.com), and `TodayEvent` DB records — cached 60s.
5. **Translation pattern**: All UI text is in Japanese; the translation table pattern allows en/th content for stores/areas/articles — the public API accepts a `locale` param.
6. **Image crop**: Upload flow always goes through `ImageCropper` (react-easy-crop) before uploading, ensuring consistent aspect ratios.
7. **Soft delete for users**: Public user deletion sets `deletedAt`, anonymizes email/nickname, keeps posts.
8. **Custom roles**: The `CustomRole` + `RolePermission` system fully extends the 3-enum roles with fine-grained per-resource CRUD permissions, assignable per admin user.

ToolSpecification.name: use_subagent
ToolSpecification.description:
⚠️ CRITICAL DELEGATION TOOL ⚠️

🔍 BEFORE attempting ANY task, CHECK if you have the required tools in YOUR current tool list.

❌ If you DON'T have the necessary tools → YOU MUST use this tool to delegate to a subagent that does.
✅ If you DO have the tools → Handle the task yourself.

## When to Use (MANDATORY scenarios):

1. **MISSING TOOLS**: The user asks you to do something but you don't see the required tool in your available tools list
   - Example: User asks to read a file, but you don't have 'fs_read' → USE THIS TOOL
   - Example: User asks to search code, but you don't have 'code' tool → USE THIS TOOL
   - Example: User asks to run bash command, but you don't have 'execute_bash' → USE THIS TOOL

2. **PARALLEL PROCESSING**: A complex task can be split into independent subtasks that different specialized agents can handle simultaneously

3. **CAPABILITY CHECK**: Use ListAgents command first to see what specialized agents and their toolsets are available

## @prompt References in Queries

You CAN pass `@prompt-name` references (including arguments) directly in the subagent query field. The system automatically resolves @prompt references before the subagent starts — the prompt content is expanded inline and the subagent receives the fully resolved text. Do NOT refuse to delegate because a query contains `@prompt-name` syntax.

Example: `{"query": "@my-task 'arg1:value1, arg2:value2'"}` — this is valid and will be resolved.

## How Subagents Are Different:
- Subagents have DIFFERENT, SPECIALIZED toolsets than you
- Each subagent may have tools you don't have access to
- They operate independently with their own context
- Up to 4 subagents can work in parallel

## Decision Flow:
```
User makes request → Check YOUR tools list → Missing required tool? → USE use_subagent
                                          → Have required tool? → Handle it yourself
```

⚡ Remember: Don't apologize about lacking tools - just delegate to a subagent that has them! Also note that subagents that are spawned together could not communicate with each other. If they are to perform tasks that are dependent on each other. Spawn them with a different tool call!

command.description: The commands to run. Allowed options are `ListAgents` to query available agents, or `InvokeSubagents` to invoke one or more subagents

query.description: The query or task to be handled by the subagent

ToolSpecification.name: code
ToolSpecification.description:
Code intelligence to analyze code with AST parsing and fuzzy search. Language auto-detected from file extension.

IMPORTANT: Prefer this tool over fs_read for code files. This tool intelligently provides structured code analysis.

CORE FEATURES:
• Fuzzy search for symbols (classes, functions, methods)
• Extracts function/class signatures via AST
• Structural AST search and rewrite (ast-grep)
• Codebase overview and directory exploration

NOTE: Use fs_read with line ranges for unsupported patterns.

## Operations

**search_symbols** - Find symbol definitions by name across workspace.
Params: symbol_name (required), path, symbol_type, limit, language, exact_match
Uses fuzzy matching by default. Set exact_match=true for precise matching.

**lookup_symbols** - Batch lookup specific symbols (max 10).
Params: symbols (required), file_path, include_source
Set include_source=false for large classes/structs to avoid context overflow.
Scoped lookup: Provide file_path to search within specific file only.

**get_document_symbols** - List all symbols in a file.
Params: file_path (required), top_level_only (recommended: true)
Use this for understanding file structure without reading content.
Prefer this over fs_read when you need symbol information.

**pattern_search** - AST-based structural search using ast-grep.
Params: pattern, language (required), file_path, limit

**pattern_rewrite** - AST-based code transformation.
Params: pattern, replacement, language (required), file_path, limit, dry_run
Use dry_run=true first to preview changes.

## Pattern Search & Rewrite

Metavariables:
• $VAR - Matches single node (identifier, expression)
• $$$ - Matches zero or more nodes (statements, parameters)

Simple patterns:
• console.log($ARG) - Match any console.log call
• function $NAME($$$PARAMS) {} - Match function declaration
• $OBJ.$METHOD() - Match any method call

Structural rules (YAML):
• pattern - Match code structure
• kind - Match AST node type (function_declaration, class_declaration)
• has - Node contains descendant matching pattern
• inside - Node is inside ancestor matching pattern
• all/any/not - Logical operators

Critical: For relational rules (has, inside), always use stopBy: end

Rewrite examples:
• pattern='var $N = $V', replacement='const $N = $V'
• pattern='$O.hasOwnProperty($P)', replacement='Object.hasOwn($O, $P)'

Workflow:
1. Use pattern_search first to verify matches
2. Review matches to ensure correctness
3. Test rewrite on small subset
4. Apply to full codebase after verification

**generate_codebase_overview** - ONLY for explicit architecture questions. Not for bug fixes or finding code.
Params: path (optional)

**search_codebase_map** - Focused directory exploration.
Params: file_path, path

## Explore Unfamiliar Code
1. search_symbols for domain-specific types/functions/methods/classes
2. lookup_symbols with include_source=true on promising matches
3. grep (max 2 searches) for literal text patterns
4. Repeat 1-3 with refined terms if needed
5. generate_codebase_overview ONLY for architecture review or full codebase understanding
   - NOT for bug fixes, feature work, or finding specific code

## Tool Selection Priority
1. search_symbols or lookup_symbols for finding code - ALWAYS use for functions/methods/classes/structs/interfaces
2. get_document_symbols for file structure
3. grep - ONLY for literal text in comments/strings, config values, code
4. fs_read - raw file content when needed

## CRITICAL RULES
- Start with search_symbols
- Always follow search_symbols with lookup_symbols
- When searching for multiple related symbols, call search_symbols in parallel

## Quick Reference
• "What's in this file?" → get_document_symbols
• "Show me X class" → search_symbols, then lookup_symbol

## LSP Operations (Not Available)
These require LSP initialization (/code init):
find_references, goto_definition, get_hover, get_completions, get_diagnostics, rename_symbol

ToolSpecification.name: session
ToolSpecification.description:
Adjust session settings temporarily (in-memory only, cleared on exit). CRITICAL: You MUST use introspect tool FIRST to verify setting names and understand their purpose before using set operation.

## Session vs Persistent Settings
- **session tool**: Temporary in-memory changes (cleared when chat exits) - Use for quick experiments or one-time adjustments
- **fs_write tool**: Permanent changes saved to disk - Use when user says "save", "persist", "permanently", or "always"
  - Global settings: ~/.kiro/settings.json
  - Workspace settings: .kiro/settings.json

## When to Use Each Tool
- User: "disable markdown" → session tool (temporary)
- User: "disable markdown permanently" → fs_write to ~/.kiro/settings.json (global) or .kiro/settings.json (workspace)
- User: "save this setting" → fs_write (persistent)
- User: "try disabling markdown" → session tool (temporary)

## REQUIRED Workflow for Setting Changes
1. User asks to change a setting
2. Use introspect tool to find the correct setting name and understand what it does
3. Determine if temporary (session) or permanent (fs_write)
4. Use appropriate tool

## Operations
- **list**: Show currently configured session settings (non-default values only)
- **get**: Get the current value of a specific setting
- **set**: Change a setting value temporarily (MUST verify setting name with introspect first)
- **reset**: Clear session override for a specific setting, or all session overrides if no key provided

## Example Workflows
Temporary change:
  User: "disable markdown"
  1. introspect(query="markdown setting") → learn about chat.disableMarkdownRendering
  2. session(operation="set", key="chat.disableMarkdownRendering", value=true)

Reset single setting:
  User: "reset markdown setting"
  session(operation="reset", key="chat.disableMarkdownRendering")

Reset all session overrides:
  User: "clear all my temporary settings"
  session(operation="reset")

Permanent change:
  User: "disable markdown permanently"
  1. introspect(query="markdown setting") → learn about chat.disableMarkdownRendering
  2. fs_write to modify ~/.kiro/settings.json with {"chat.disableMarkdownRendering": true}

DO NOT guess setting names - always verify with introspect first.

key.description: Setting key (e.g., 'chat.disableMarkdownRendering'). Required for 'get' and 'set' operations. Optional for 'reset' (if omitted, resets all session overrides). MUST be verified with introspect tool first.

value.description: Value to set. Type depends on the setting (boolean, string, or number). Required for 'set' operation

operation.description: The operation to perform: 'list' shows configured settings, 'get' retrieves a specific setting, 'set' changes a setting value temporarily, 'reset' clears session override(s)

ToolSpecification.name: fs_read
ToolSpecification.description:
Tool for reading files, directories and images. Always provide an 'operations' array.

For single operation: provide array with one element.
For batch operations: provide array with multiple elements.

Available modes:
- Line: Read lines from a file
- Directory: List directory contents
- Search: Search for patterns in files
- Image: Read and process images

Examples:
1. Single: {"operations": [{"mode": "Line", "path": "/file.txt"}]}
2. Batch: {"operations": [{"mode": "Line", "path": "/file1.txt"}, {"mode": "Search", "path": "/file2.txt", "pattern": "test"}]}

operations.description: Array of operations to execute. Provide one element for single operation, multiple for batch.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination (optional, for Directory mode). Use with max_entries to iterate through large directories. Entries are sorted by last modified time (most recent first). Default: 0

path.description: Path to the file or directory. The path should be absolute, or otherwise start with ~ for the user's home (required for Line, Directory, Search modes).

depth.description: Depth of a recursive directory listing (optional, for Directory mode)

image_paths.description: List of paths to the images. This is currently supported by the Image mode.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries to return (optional, for Directory mode). When limit is reached, results are truncated and metadata shows 'showing X of Y entries'. Use to prevent context window overflow. Default: 1000

pattern.description: Pattern to search for (required, for Search mode). Case insensitive. The pattern matching is performed per line.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from directory listing (optional, for Directory mode). If omitted, uses defaults. If empty array [] is provided, no exclusions are applied (shows everything). If patterns are provided, they completely override the defaults. Examples: '**/target/**', '*.log'

start_line.description: Starting line number (optional, for Line mode). A negative index represents a line number starting from the end of the file.

mode.description: The operation mode to run in: `Line`, `Directory`, `Search`. `Line` and `Search` are only for text files, and `Directory` is only for directories. `Image` is for image files, in this mode `image_paths` is required.

end_line.description: Ending line number (optional, for Line mode). A negative index represents a line number starting from the end of the file.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines around search results (optional, for Search mode)

summary.description: Optional description of the purpose of this batch operation (mainly useful for multiple operations)

model_info.description: Models chosen by task for optimal usage and consistent quality
